materialization_rule: For each ordered_main_run_stages item, write each preservation_receipts.raw_json exactly as UTF-8, verify receipt_sha256, then pass those paths to the existing recovery entry point in this same order. No refit, prediction, encoder, simulator or policy service was invoked. Source-provenance correction is recorded separately; use the v2 preservation receipt.

separate_cpu_model_preparation.scope: Separate already verified small zip, not a main-run tar stage. Do not pass this record to the tar recovery entry point.
